_readme: Client reviews for the homepage. The section stays completely hidden until this list has at least one review.
To add a review: copy one entry below into the list, fill it in, save. The website updates by itself (no other step).
Only add REAL reviews, in the client's own words, from clients who agreed to be quoted. Never invent or reword one.
Fields: name (required: first name and last initial is fine), text (required: the review, exactly as written),
permission (required: must be true, meaning the client said you can show it; entries without it are never shown),
area (optional, e.g. Forest Hill), project (optional, e.g. Front door), date (optional, e.g. June 2026),
stars (optional, 1 to 5: only add it if the client actually gave a star rating).
